abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.

Table 3. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 190 | 450 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 205 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 182 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Blood pressure control | 225 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
